svg.title: The Slipping Glyph: Illuminated initials
svg.desc: The Slipping Glyph (1D): a carved surface of glyphs drawn as painted, gilded initials inside a vine border. Only the glyph under the gold focus circle is lit and holds still; a glyph just outside it is mid-change, its old parts sliding away as new ones appear, while one part (here the foot) stays the same. The rune key on the left does not slip, and the slots on the right take one rune per row: the first row is solved, the second is being chosen.
svg.text: Watch what stays. Sketches blur in five seconds.
